subject: Veridian Health CAIQ: mapping deep-dive and exhibit request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@veridianhealth.com>, Veridian Security Team <security@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian Health CAIQ: mapping deep-dive and exhibit request

Hi Lisa / Veridian security team,

Thanks again for sending the CAIQ. I pulled an initial controls mapping and attached a first-pass spreadsheet (veridian_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx) that aligns Veridian's question set to our CCM/claim IDs and the owners inside Redwood.

What I'm proposing: a 45-minute technical deep-dive where we walk the top 20 controls you're prioritizing (based on the spreadsheet's "priority" column) and agree on the precise exhibits you'll accept. Typical exhibits we provide are: config screenshots, runtime audit log samples (redacted), IAM policy snapshots, and paraphrased control narratives tied to code/infra.

Ask: could you confirm the three highest-priority control IDs you want evidence for in the first window? In our experience most customers pick a mix across identity, network segmentation and telemetry (examples in the sheet: ID-1 / IAM-3 / LOG-7). If you can share any required formats (CSV snippets, date ranges for log samples), mention that too.

I've cc'd Marissa (evidence orchestration) and Neha (compliance intake) — they'll coordinate artifact collection and upload.

Proposed times (PST): Thu 2/18 9:00 or 11:00; Fri 2/19 10:00. If none work, send a couple of options and we'll adapt.

Attachments: veridian_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference
---
Karthik Iyer | karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Veridian Security Team <security@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Veridian Health CAIQ: mapping deep-dive and exhibit request

Hi Karthik,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. The team reviewed and we'd like to prioritize the following CAIQ/CCM items for the first submission: NET-6 (network segmentation), IAM-3 (privileged account controls), and LOG-4 (retention and tamper-evidence).

A couple of constraints on our side: for LOG-4 we need samples that cover a 30-day window and must be redacted at the user level before upload. For IAM-3 include role-to-user mappings and the most recent rotation timestamp for admin keys. For NET-6, configuration snapshots (VPC/subnet ACLs) plus a diagram are fine.

We can do Thu 2/18 at 11:00 EST (that should be 08:00 PST?) — sorry timezone math: 11:00 EST is 08:00 PST; either 08:00 or 11:00 PST works for us if you meant Pacific. If your team prefers a later PST slot, let us know.

Also, please send instructions for a secure artifact upload (SFTP, secure drive, or our vendor portal). We prefer a scoped expiry link if possible.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Cheng
Sr. Security Program Manager, Veridian Health
security@veridianhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 07:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian Health CAIQ: mapping deep-dive and exhibit request

> Appreciate the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. The team reviewed and we'd like to prioritize the following CAIQ/CCM items for the first submission: NET-6 (network segmentation), IAM-3 (privileged account controls), and LOG-4 (retention and tamper-evidence).

Got it — I'll own NET-6 artifacts (network diagrams, VPC ACL snapshots). Neha, can you pick up LOG-4 redacted log window and confirm the exact time range Lisa needs? Karthik, I'll need a short blurb linking each artifact to the control language (1-2 sentences per artifact) so we can keep the reviewer narrative tight.

Attachments I'll prepare for the call:
- network_diagram_v1.pdf (diagram)
- vpc_acl_snapshot_20270201.txt (config excerpt)
- upload_instructions_draft.docx (SFTP + secure-drive options)

I'll also add a small slide that maps the artifact to the CAIQ question text so Veridian's reviewer can crosswalk quickly.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Evidence Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@auditbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian Health CAIQ: mapping deep-dive and exhibit request

Lisa — thanks, confirmed for Thu 2/18 at 11:00 EST / 08:00 PST. Agenda for the 45-minute session:

1) Quick introductions (5m)
2) Walk NET-6 artifacts (10m) — Marissa to present diagram + ACL snapshots
3) Walk IAM-3 artifacts (10m) — I will present role mappings and rotation timestamps
4) Walk LOG-4 artifacts & redaction approach (10m) — Neha to show scrubbed sample
5) Next steps & upload procedure (10m)

Action items I own before the call:
- Finalize the control-claim narrative (attached: redwood_control_claims_excerpt.pdf) linking Redwood infra to CAIQ phrasing
- Provide the secure upload options and a scoped link workflow (draft attached: evidence_upload_instructions.docx)

Tom — looped you in in case AuditBridge wants to observe the walk-through.

If that agenda looks good, I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short recording consent line. If you prefer to use Veridian's vendor portal for artifact delivery, we'll use that instead (please send access details).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Karthik
Principal, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference
